title: A bill to designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 155 South Main Street in Mount Clemens, Michigan, as the "Lieutenant Colonel Alexander Jefferson Post Office".
official_summary: This act designates the facility of the U.S. Postal Service located at 155 South Main Street in Mount Clemens, Michigan, as the Lieutenant Colonel Alexander Jefferson Post Office.

summary.headline: A federal law renames the Mount Clemens, Michigan post office at 155 South Main Street after Lieutenant Colonel Alexander Jefferson.
summary.what_it_does: This act officially names the U.S. Postal Service facility at 155 South Main Street in Mount Clemens, Michigan, the Lieutenant Colonel Alexander Jefferson Post Office. It changes only the official name of the building. It does not change mail service, postal rules, or staffing.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on October 1, 2024.
